The support agent is asking for the full credit card number in a chat window to 'verify' a refund. Legitimate companies never ask for full card details (especially the full number) over chat for security reasons; they typically only need the last 4 digits or can process the refund to the original payment method without the user re-entering the full number. This is a major security red flag for a phishing attempt or insecure data handling.
